pack.name: Official Reasoning / Math / Knowledge
pack.description: Compact quantitative and factual reasoning tasks with bounded deterministic answer checks.

benchmark.name: Math and Knowledge Essentials
benchmark.description: Short questions whose intended answer can be compared with deterministic normalized text.

tasks.name: Compute a weighted average
tasks.prompt: Solve the quantitative problem carefully and return the requested final value. Keep the final answer unambiguous.

cases.prompt: A result has scores 10, 20, and 30 with weights 1, 2, and 1. What is the weighted average? Return only the number.

tasks.name: Check a factual claim
tasks.prompt: Assess the claim using stable general knowledge. State the result and the shortest sufficient correction.

cases.prompt: Is the statement `Earth is the only planet in the Solar System with a natural satellite` correct? Return `False: several planets have natural satellites.` if it is not.
cases.expected: False: several planets have natural satellites.

criteria.name: Numeric correctness
criteria.description: Produces the exact requested normalized value.

criteria.name: Format discipline
criteria.description: Keeps the final answer unambiguous and free of irrelevant alternatives.

criteria.name: Fact correctness
criteria.description: Correctly accepts or rejects the stated claim.

criteria.name: Correction quality
criteria.description: Gives the concise correction required by the case.

execution.requirement: Text generation only; string expectations use deterministic line-ending and surrounding-whitespace normalization.
